facts.summary: Updated interim survival data announced, 64% 12-month OS · Phase 1/2 · atebimetinib in first-line pancreatic cancer · not yet approved

evidence.summary: 64% overall survival (“OS”) at 12 months (with median follow-up time of 13.4 months) was observed in the initial intent-to-treat population of 34 patients
evidence.safety: No Grade 5 TEAEs were observed in this patient population and no new safety signals were identified.
evidence.program_discontinued: Dosing the first patient in a pivotal Phase 3 clinical trial of atebimetinib in combination with mGnP in first-line pancreatic cancer patients, in mid-2026.
